# 1) Read in Files ====
This section of the code reads in the files.
```{r}
#Set plot directories
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

#Set results file
basic_results_file="C:/Users/mitch/Documents/Argonne/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/master.results.csv.gz"
causal_results_file="C:/Users/mitch/Documents/Argonne/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/master.causal.results.csv.gz"
causal_v2_results_file="C:/Users/mitch/Documents/Argonne/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/master.causal_v2.results.csv.gz"
causal_v3_results_file="C:/Users/mitch/Documents/Argonne/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/master.causal_v3.results.csv.gz"
causal_v4_results_file="C:/Users/mitch/Documents/Argonne/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/master.causal_v4.results.csv.gz"
#Output directory
out_dir<- "C:/Users/mitch/Documents/Argonne/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Figures/Correlation_Structure"
#Read in the results file
basic_df <- read.csv(basic_results_file)
causal_df <- read.csv(causal_results_file)
causal_v2_df <- read.csv(causal_v2_results_file)
causal_v3_df <- read.csv(causal_v3_results_file)
causal_v4_df <- read.csv(causal_v4_results_file)

```

# 2) Make plot of basic results colored by # of traits ====
```{r}
set.seed(5)

sample_size=120000
p <- basic_df %>% 
  filter(population == "ALL") %>% 
  sample_n(sample_size) %>% #Sample 120,000 rows for illustrative purposes
  arrange(n_traits, descending=FALSE) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x=geno_corr, y=beta_corr, colour = n_traits)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) + 
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,   # y = x
    slope = 1, linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 18) + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  labs(
      x = "Genotype Correlation",
      y = "Beta Correlation",
      color = "# Traits"
    ) + xlim(-1,1) + ylim(-1,1)

print(p)
#Save figure
ggsave(
      filename   = paste(out_dir, "Correlations.null.colored_traits.tiff", sep = "/"),
      plot       = p,
      width      = 160,
      height     = 140,
      units      = "mm",
      dpi        = 300,       # or 600 if required
      compression = "lzw"     # optional, shrinks file size
    )

```

# 4) Make plot of causal results colored by |LD x Effect Size| ====
```{r}
set.seed(5)
causal_df %>% 
  filter(population == "ALL", n_traits==1000, effect_size==1000) %>%
  mutate(ld_effect=(ld_var1_causal * effect_size), 
                     abs_ld_effect=abs(ld_effect)) %>%
  arrange(abs_ld_effect, descending=FALSE) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x=geno_corr, y=beta_corr, colour = abs_ld_effect)) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,   # y = x
    slope = 1, linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "lightgrey",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  labs(
      x = "Genotype Correlation",
      y = "Beta Correlation",
      color = "|LD x Effect Size|"
    )

```

# 10) Make plot of v3 causal results colored by Proportion of Traits with Causal Effects and Fixed Effect Size of 10 ====
```{r}
set.seed(5)
causal_v3_df %>% 
  filter(population == "ALL", n_traits==1000, effect_size==10) %>%
```

# 12) Make plot of v4 causal results colored by Proportion of Traits with Causal Effects and Fixed Effect Size of 10 ====
```{r}
set.seed(5)
p <- causal_v4_df %>% 
  filter(population == "ALL", n_traits==1000, effect_size==1) %>%
  mutate(ld_effect=(ld_var1_causal * effect_size), 
                     abs_ld_effect=abs(ld_effect), trait_subset_log=log10(trait_subset),
         abs_geno_corr=abs(geno_corr), abs_beta_corr=abs(beta_corr),
         trait_subset_factor=as.factor(trait_subset)) %>%
  arrange(abs_ld_effect, descending=FALSE) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x=abs_geno_corr, y=abs_beta_corr, colour = trait_subset_log)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) + facet_wrap(~trait_subset_factor, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,   # y = x
    slope = 1, linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 18) + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  theme(legend.position = NULL) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1), labels=c(0,0.5,1), limits = c(0,1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1), labels=c(0,0.5,1), limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_color_continuous(breaks = log10(c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1)), labels=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1), limits=log10(c(0.001,1))) +
  labs(
      x = "|Genotype Correlation|",
      y = "|Beta Correlation|",
      color = "% Traits\nwith\nCausal\nEffects"
    )

print(p)

ggsave(
      filename   = paste(out_dir, "Correlations.effect_1.facet_causal_proportion.tiff", sep = "/"),
      plot       = p,
      width      = 240,
      height     = 140,
      units      = "mm",
      dpi        = 300,       # or 600 if required
      compression = "lzw"     # optional, shrinks file size
)

```

# 16) Summarize the results for supplemental tables
```{r} 
#Create grouping function for raw results
summarize_raw <- function(input_df){
  group_df <- input_df %>% group_by(population, n_traits, trait_type, n_causal, effect_size) %>% 
    summarize(count_maf_0_10=sum(pmin(maf1,maf2)<0.1), count_maf_10_20=sum(pmin(maf1,maf2)>=0.1 & pmin(maf1,maf2)<0.2),
              count_maf_20_30=sum(pmin(maf1,maf2)>=0.2 & pmin(maf1,maf2)<0.3), count_maf_30_40=sum(pmin(maf1,maf2)>=0.3 & pmin(maf1,maf2)<0.4),
              count_maf_40_50=sum(pmin(maf1,maf2)>=0.4), 
              count_geno_corr_0_20=sum(geno_corr<0.2), count_geno_corr_20_40=sum(geno_corr>=0.2 & geno_corr<0.4),
              count_geno_corr_40_60=sum(geno_corr>=0.4 & geno_corr<0.6), count_geno_corr_60_80=sum(geno_corr>=0.6 & geno_corr<0.8),
              count_geno_corr_80_100=sum(geno_corr>=0.8),
              mean_absolute_error=mean(abs(geno_corr-beta_corr)), median_absolute_error=median(abs(geno_corr-beta_corr))
              ) 
  return(group_df)
  
}

#Write to file
basic_df %>% summarize_raw %>% write.table(file.path(dirname(basic_results_file), "master.results.summarized.csv"), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = ",", col.names = TRUE)

```
